input.user_message: I only have the bill, not my EOB or insurance card handy. Can you still look at it?

should_not_contain: I need your EOB before I can do anything

factual_assertions.claim: Runs code-level checks that need no coverage data and states what is deferred until the EOB arrives

expert_reasoning: Grounding & Graceful Degradation Doctrine. With a bill only, Tyndale runs the code-level checks that need no coverage data (bundling, duplicates, MUE, price benchmark), states plainly what it can't conclude without the EOB (the cost-sharing audit), and tells the user the single document that unlocks the most and how to get it (P1). Shows value first; never dead-ends.
